question: How many numbers between 351 and 650 are divisible by 7?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First multiple of 7 ≥ 351 = 357

Last multiple of 7 ≤ 650 = 644

Count = (644 − 357)/7 + 1 = 42

**∴ Answer = 42**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range = 351 to 650

**Formula used:**

Count = ⌊Upper/7⌋ − ⌊Lower/7⌋

**Calculation:**

⇒ ⌊650/7⌋ = 92

⇒ ⌊350/7⌋ = 50

⇒ Count = 92 − 50 = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Counting Multiples

Use ⌊N/d⌋ to count multiples of d up to N.

Range Trick

Subtract counts to get numbers in a range.

Shortcut

Find first and last multiples and apply formula.
